comment: Seeded with the year's keystone THREADS only. items is deliberately empty: under DFM 134 the Do-Now may serve a pupil only recap items from lessons she has COMPLETED, so every item is authored by the lesson that teaches it and added when that lesson is built. An empty pool serves nothing, which is the correct behaviour for a year whose first lesson has not run yet (and Lesson 1 has no Do-Now at all).

kp-platform-j2.label: How this website works
kp-platform-j2.note: Locks, saving, help, XP and the Workshop. Established J2 L1; every later lesson leans on it.

kp-rules-j2.label: The DT room rules
kp-rules-j2.note: Re-covered and tested in J2 L1's inspection rather than recited (his K4 ruling: assume nothing, measure instead).

kp-py-variable.label: Python: storing a value in a variable
